rationale: Iteration 8 raced ki 1.2 and scored 187.18, below the iteration 7 best of 216.97 at ki 1.0. Oval progress fell (0.728 to 0.633) and finish rate dropped (4/20 to 2/20). S-bend steering_oscillation rose to 0.339, close to the 0.35 limit, and s-bend progress fell (0.462 to 0.472, roughly flat). The ki curve is 184.93 at 0.8, 216.97 at 1.0 and 187.18 at 1.2. A parabola through those three points peaks at about ki 1.00, so further ki changes are unlikely to help. I therefore return to the iteration 7 design exactly (ki 1.0, kp 3.0, kd 0.5, base_speed 1.6, outer sensors at x = ±0.04, sensor_size 0.016, last_direction). It is the only raced design that scored above 200, and its s-bend progress (0.462) and slalom progress (0.1235) meet the thresholds. Residual max_error (about 0.06 m) and the oval finish rate (0.2) remain the open problems. I did not test kd 0.6 because kd 0.3 to 0.5 already raised s-bend oscillation from 0.15 to 0.33, so a further step risks crossing the 0.35 limit. Expected result: a score of about 217, matching the iteration 7 race under the same seeds. Measurements wanted: per-track progress, max_error, steering_oscillation, line_loss_events and oval completion_time, to confirm the reproduced result and to give a baseline for any kd or base_speed test in a later iteration.
